holderPosition.legalForm: Contingent Payout Note: a senior unsecured, non-interest-bearing debt security of RepublicX LLC (Delaware), with a keepwell agreement of OpenDeal Inc. whose terms are unpublished, represented by tokens on a proprietary Republic security-token standard on Solana
holderPosition.says: The holder is a senior unsecured creditor of RepublicX for a pro rata share of the value of a SpaceX common share, payable in USD or a stablecoin after the earlier of a Qualified Liquidity Event or maturity (3 November 2035), less fees inside the Reference Price. RepublicX holds nothing against the notes, and the holder has no equity in SpaceX, RepublicX or Republic; the payout formula and the keepwell are not public.

tokens.note: Republic says the notes are represented by tokens minted 'using a Republic-created security token asset standard'. No mint address is published in any filing or page, and Jupiter searches return only impersonation memecoins (2026-09-17).

outside.says: 'Described in the Notes and the Offering Documents', which are not public; the governing-law clause of the instrument is also unread.

The offering page was rewritten between captures (bankruptcy and tender offer added as triggers, issuer-chosen stablecoin, dated maturity, removal of the $275 proportion); nothing says which version governs an earlier note.

A premium is built into the Reference Price and other platform fees reduce the payout; no rate is published. RepublicX pays Republic Core $150,000 onboarding and $75,000 a quarter (Republic Core Form C-AR).
'Designed to be tradable on INX ... subject to market conditions and eligibility', at RepublicX's full discretion; 'investors should not expect a secondary market to develop'.

verdict.summary: The holder's position is clear on the issuer's own pages: senior unsecured debt of RepublicX with nothing held against it. But no mint is published, so no statement in Tokenizario can be about the token at all, while the only readable 'rSpaceX' mint is an impersonator. What the holder will actually be paid depends on an unpublished formula and an unnamed calculation agent's choice of basis after the split, so the core cannot be said. Not 'not-a-token', because Republic states the notes are tokenized on Solana and a restricted mint could exist unseen.
